verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents browser actions (click, wait, scroll) that can run before a scrape or extraction, which supports some interactive page manipulation, but there is no evidence of form-filling, typing credentials, or a persistent multi-step session capable of reaching authenticated/login-walled content. Missing for 10: explicit support for filling login forms/typing input, session/cookie persistence across interactions, and any documented login-wall use case or example.
